identityPolicy: Aliases are title mappings supported by current identity evidence. Historical serials/title records are not mapped to a new current title unless current serial identity is independently confirmed. Never identify a journal by abbreviation alone.
normalizationNote: The collector normalizer now maps ampersand to AND like scraper/lib/identity.js. Three mappings are therefore also recognized by normalized title; six require an explicit title alias.
